claims.statement: For every rank-(m-2) physical shield P with arbitrary Boolean core, every finite adaptive/pruned restriction tree on P variables, and every arbitrary common disjoint terminal core h, U(Ph)-sum_l w_l U(P_l h)<=2I(P), uniformly in all parameters.
The retained loss is bounded by twice the first-query influence plus the signed leaf packet sum_l w_l[2I(P_l)-U(P_l)]; the leaf packet is not asserted nonnegative after control restrictions.
U(P)<=I(P) for every arbitrary-orientation nullity-two shield; independent exhaustive affine-phase tests at m=3 and samples at m=4 had maximum ratio one, but no proof is known.
No dimension-independent retained-credit theorem covers arbitrary changing higher-nullity coherent cores through an unrestricted hierarchy.
